problem_markdown: The original insufficiency on this branch was that malformed or forward-incompatible typed proto input could silently decode a present guard as if the branch were unguarded. This round closed that `F3` gap with fail-fast decoding and regression coverage, so no issue-local implementation work remains on the current branch state.

A nontrivial `MatchGuard` never counts as coverage for totality or reachability; only the effectively-trivial case participates as unguarded.

steps.title: Fail Fast on Invalid Typed BranchGuard Payloads

summary_markdown: Finish scoped match-branch guards so every compiler phase and typed IR tool honors the same binder model for `case p_outer if expr matches p_inner:`: match the outer pattern first, evaluate the guard scrutinee once, check the inner guard pattern and optional inner guard, then run the branch body in `outerBindings ++ guardBindings`. Preserve right-most-wins shadowing through typed substitution, recursion analysis, loop/recur lowering, Matchless lowering, and proto/EDN tooling, keep totality conservative except for effectively-trivial guards, and fail closed on invalid guard encodings without backend schema growth.
